chapters: Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan oidha' jix gaki tu jiim vupui bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Paraan gu Topel gu Labaan gu aserot gu Disaab.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch dɨr gu oreb gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.

Ba' jix aa' ka't oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Moab guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Moisees jix duu dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kavɨk gu Amorreo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix maa gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' ba'k bia'ka' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' bham; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p mambhɨɨx gɨ' mui'kim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bopxi'ñ gu chio'ñ mamatdagɨm pui'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu chio'ñ mamatdagɨm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ xibhɨk ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jix ali' na ja'p jix gɨ' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' cham gui'x choo'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' kuiñcha ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx dua'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oreb guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Amorreo na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu kavɨk gu Amorreo gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa vupui bhaan tu' gu oidha'; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Eskol guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios aichdhak jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gui'p; gio ba' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa va'k guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' vaak jodai vaak zel bham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Amorreo na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' duukat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Nuestros gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ no'ch jɨ'dɨlh vaak jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' oidha' jix gaki buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p jix duu gu chio'ñ gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx dhi' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt na ba' tu jiim pai' dua'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bɨɨx gu tai gu tukaa' na ba' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx toov gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ oi'ñdha' dhi' ja'tkam dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu jix bhai' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio bhaan tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhai' tu' cham bhai' jɨjɨkgɨm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr no'ch guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham chɨɨdak naak; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ja'p xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Seir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm gu orma.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga naak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Kades guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu Bolbimos guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu Seir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' bhɨi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Seir guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ɨɨbhi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kɇkɇɇda' jix jai'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx; na cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaas tɨɨt; na gu' tu' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu Esauu gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ koi' jugi; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' i'i.

Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx tu duukam gu noobh; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Elat gu Esiongeber; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Moab.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Moab tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu oidha'; na gu' tu' jix maa gu Ar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Lot.
Jano' ba' gu Emimeos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ va'k gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Moabitas mɨmɨim gu Emimeos.

Jano' ba' gu Seir guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ va'k gu oreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix duu gu Israeel gu oidha' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sered; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sered.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sered jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨx jix duu gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gio gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham tu' duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook koi bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' gu Moab gu Ar.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx; na gu' cham tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu ma'nkam gu Lot jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ammonitas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Somsommeos.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Ammonitas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir vupui bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oreos; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu ebeos oi'ñka' gu aserin bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa gu Kaptoreos moor gu Kaptor guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix maa gu novɨ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Amorreo gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kua'da' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ɨɨbhi'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim jix duu dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Kademot gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt jix duu cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jugi bi'iix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ jugi; gio ba' gu suudai' gio maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ i'ya'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir gu Moabitas oi'ñka' gu Ar; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ na ba' kɨɨsa' gu novɨ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' kua'da' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' gu Seoon gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Seoon guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jaas.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho vupui bhaan no'ch; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' no'ch gu vaakax guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨ'dɨlh dua'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon kiicham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu Galaad cham ka't kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ no'ch; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' bɨx jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jabok tu' jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk tu' pai' oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbimos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n na gu' gu novɨ dhagia' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu esboon.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vaak jodai bɨɨx kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mumua'da' jɨ'dɨlh cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' gu Sidonios mɨmɨim gu ermoon gu Sirioon; gio ba' gu Amorreos gu Senir; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu Galaad bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix kavɨk jodai cham gu Rabbat gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maakobh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ novɨ maa'nkar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu Galaad bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh tu' gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Galaad bɨx gu Basaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og tu' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨx gu Basaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Gessuri gu Makâti; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Basaan-abot-jair bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Makîr tu' gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas tu' gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jabok gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam gu Jordaan gu oidha' dɨr gu Kineret bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Pisga tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ a'aalh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' namki' jix jai' gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh jix maa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gio gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'n gu maa'nkar tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gio gu Josuee jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'.
Jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bham.

Na ba' na ba' jix duu mua'kam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨtmo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh dodhia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Beser oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Rubenitas; gio ba' gu Ramot gu Galaad gu Gaditas; mi' dhɨr gu Golaan gu Basaan gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Bet-peor gu oidha' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tas.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Pisga.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maatɨt; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch gu oreb.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx no'ch bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ko'iix.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.

Jano' ba' tu' ka't jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios choo'n gu tai cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bham.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' na jax chu'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jiix gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu bɨx tu duukam.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' matgɨm tu duukam jix duu tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' ja'tkam na tu juan tu' gu vaakax tu' buur tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim kiki'ñgob; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka'.

Jano' ba' gu onra gu taat gu naan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu na ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham daipu' ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut bhaan tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak tɨtmo tu' gu oidha' tu' tu duukam tu' ja'tkam na tu juan tu' gu vaakax tu' buur tu' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't tɨtmo.

Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai toov gu tukgam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr ua'na gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai jix maa tu'.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukgam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ daraa.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim koi dhi' gu tai guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios koi.

Jano' ba' na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu chuukug na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p no'ch guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' daipu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook no'ch guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chulhiiñchuda'.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr naak gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' xoi'kam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu tanoolh bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ma'nkam jum duu xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaak zel.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tanoolh gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' bia'ka'.

Na ba' na ba' jum i'obh gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' gu mar bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bii'm suudai' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ no'm bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam tu ñi'ook kua' gu vaak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat gu novɨ no'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu vaak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx xoi'kam tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' jix duu tu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jum i'obh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p vaak zel gu Massa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk tu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tattat.
Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu' tu ñi'ook gu mar bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daipu' gu mar; gio ba' no'ch jɨɨ'ñdhat tu duukam gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios buimɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Ejipto bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan bɨx gu vaak vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui.

Jano' ba' na ja'p chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan na ba' baakɨi guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk tu' jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan tu' gu tai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' ba' gu kavɨk oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai ua'ñix bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't ua'nak jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu tanoolh bɨx ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu jodai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; na tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tai bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan gook gu noobh.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu Aaroon gio bhaam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham tu' duu; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aaroon jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' kakneer tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu tu' maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar na jix maa gu noobh.

Gu' gu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan gu Lebita guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham jix duu gu Lebita bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu Komeree gu chuukug na gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ jugi jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' koo'nda' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa na ja'p tu' jix duu tu' jugi kiki'ñgob bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' na jix bhai' jugi gio.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham jugi gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; na pai' dhuuk na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na pai' dhuuk tu jiim jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'x jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk jix nukadham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas na pai' dhuuk tu jiim jix bhai' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam pai' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' bia'ka' jix duu jix daa gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mi' dhɨr ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gio.

Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨɨtki' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' cham maa'n naak gu ñi'ook tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨɨtki'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' maachim tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨɨtki' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix koi; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios xibhɨk gu mar gu naan gu mar mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ bham ɨxchuixim; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' tattat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam xikoolh mia'n tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' dɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx tu' maa'n naak; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam uañi'ñka' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' va'k kooda'; gio ba' gu novɨ ka't maa'n bhaan na ba' mu'aa' mi' dhɨr gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bɨɨx gu jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.

Na ba' na ba' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Tema cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn nɨidhim dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiicham bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu'r guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhuu tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr kiicham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx bɨx bhɨɨya' gio gu vaakax guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨrban guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gɨ' kavɨk na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios dɨlhkob i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' jix maa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix koi.

Na gu' na gu' jix duu gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi; gio ba' gu vaakax kaneer chiiw.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chiiw dodhia' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaakax dodhia' chiiw gɨ' kavɨk.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam juraa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jugi.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' ja'tkam cham jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn namki' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' jix ai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' cham namki' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' juraa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug suulhgia' cham jugi tu' kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' dhi' jugi bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx juraa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx cham palhɨɨp guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim cham jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' cham jugi; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Asor guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan na jax chu'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.

Jano' ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jugi; gio ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chiiw bii'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mambhɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam yooxi' oidha' tas.

Jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim tu' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bi'iix guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tuumiñ gu novɨ ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' maa'n tuumiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kakneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' u'va guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu i'ii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Lebita guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na gu' cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix buusñi bɨx mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Lebita cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jugi ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx tu duukam gu noobh tu jiim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' uañi'ñka' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨtmo xibhɨk; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gu' xibhɨk palhɨɨp guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ uañi'ñka' gu novɨ.

Na ba' na ba' cham ka't tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix kai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' tu' gu ja'tkam oi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai'.
Gu' gu' bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bham; gio ba' mia'n oidha' tas kɨɨv guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan xibhɨk gu ja'tkam na ba' cham jix duu; na guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim uañi'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk tu jiim; na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx tu jiim gu novɨ.

Na gu' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' xibhɨk gu ebreo gu ebrea tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kɨɨv oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam namkidhat tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duu namkidhat tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kakneer ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' maa'n mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨndak; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' gu vaak tu' xoi'kam bɨndak.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm naak ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob ka't tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gio jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk tɨip namkidhat tu'; na guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kakneer.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi oidha' tas tu' ja'tkam vaak pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bai'ñchu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ no'x guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' na jix bhai' jugi na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib jix duu gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abib tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' cham jugi bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx gu tanoolh pai'.

Jano' ba' cham kiicha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jabka' bɨndak bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chuukug kooda' gu xumai maa'n gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix matgɨm jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.

Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat pai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xumai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duu tu duukam.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' dɨr kua'da' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kua'da' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kɨɨv guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ ka't tu jiim bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan gu Lebita guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam gu Ejipto; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
